cues.note: high above Paris, day 1889: wind, a far fairground band and crowd murmur that thins out as the camera climbs, then the warm restaurant murmur, cutlery and a faint string trio when it lands at the window
BIGZOOM: a long rising airy whoosh / swoosh with a gentle pitch rise as the camera dives across the city and up the lattice
the camera passes through the lattice girders: a quick iron whoomp, close to the first platform
landing on Maupassant: soft glass-and-room 'pop' as the window room tone arrives
first happy bite on 'กินข้าวบนหอ': fork clinks on the plate, a blissful nasal hum without words (mouth stays still)
second bite, napkin rustle and a glass tinkle
9-frame dissolve into shot 25 (inside, same table): the outdoor wind fades to the room tone
